static_traits.name: 林若薇
static_traits.occupation: 餐馆员工兼纸杯蛋糕生意老板
static_traits.family_status: Married育有子Female，需负责接送孩子上学
static_traits.social_status: 与同事关系因迟到而紧张；配偶支持但支持有限
static_traits.medical_history: 既往without心理治疗史；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度较高，语气中性但带有挫败感；常use绝对化表述（如“永远not可能准时”）

basic_info.main_problem: 我总觉得自己永远not可能准时，因为送孩子上学后我总是上班迟到，这导致压力和内疚。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because persistent lateness has affected my work performance and caused stress in my personal life.
growth_experiences: 生育孩子后开始在餐馆工作，早晨需要先送孩子到学校，再赶往工作地点。随着时间推移，通勤交通拥堵与早晨准备的匆忙使迟到频率增高，压力与内疚not断累积，进而影响自尊与与同事的互动；虽然配偶具有支持性并在可行时协助，但其工作限制使支持not足以解决问题。

special_situations.event: 早晨送孩子到学校后遇到通勤拥堵，导致上班打卡迟到
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能同时满足家庭与工作的时间要求，就说明我not负责任/失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 设定多个闹钟、优化早晨日程、加快节奏以挤压时间

special_situations.event: 老板因迟到表现出not满，工作表现受到影响
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人对我not满，就说明我就是not负责任的人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 内疚自责、加班或更快完成任务以弥补
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们觉得我not负责任/not投入

special_situations.event: 准备与老板沟通调整工作时间，但not确定对方是否会同意
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果老板not同意，我就have not办法解决问题，我会一直迟到
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 犹豫not决、反复权衡而推迟行动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她大概not会同意，这方案not会奏效

special_situations.event: 出门前就感到高度匆忙与紧张，担心早晨流程被打乱
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果开局not完美，后面就一定会崩坏
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在有限时间里塞入更多任务、not断加速以“抢时间”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 今天又会迟到，一切都会搞砸

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被视为可靠并同时胜任Mother与员工的角色
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被老板和同事认为not负责任、被责备或影响工作稳定；害怕without法照顾好孩子
defense_goal: 通过加倍控制与自我苛责来维持秩序并减轻内疚
避免直接面对Being rejected的可能以降低Anxiety

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing taking action (such as communicating with the boss to adjust work hours) or being judged by others for being late
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将老板的not满泛化为他人会negate自己，主观认定“他们认为我not负责任”。
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用温和、Empathy的语气，承认其担忧，同时适度挑战其假设；use开放式问题引导其将担心具体化，并鼓励进行小步尝试。

manifestations: After childbirth, she takes on both parenting and work roles; morning time is constrained by external arrangements and transportation, making it hard to control
Highly attached to the value condition of 'must be on time', feels bound by rules and responsibilities
对调整工时或use校车等选择持not确定与顾虑

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 主观认定同事觉得自己not负责任/not投入
预设老板not会同意调整工时

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自我责备与内疚，将迟到归因于品性问题
在早晨not断自我审查与加速，试图“抢时间”

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Emphasizes 'I must be on time' and 'I should care for the children well and arrive at work on time'
以绝对化规则评估自我价值，导致压力与内疚加剧

positive_force: Has a supportive spouse协助育儿
愿意尝试与老板沟通调整工时
已经尝试多种策略（设闹钟、优化日程、寻求帮助）
具备理性分析与方案评估的能力
negative_force: 存在非黑即白、预测not yet来、灾难化等认知偏差
过度关注他人评价，担心被视为not负责任
晨间时间结构与通勤环境限制（送学与交通拥堵）
内疚与压力长期累积，Impaired self-esteem

antecedent: 出门前已感到匆忙与紧张
target_behavior.core_reason: 在家庭与工作双重角色冲突中，时间管理受限并伴随“我永远not可能准时”的灾难化/绝对化认知
target_behavior.function: 优先完成育儿任务以获得短期安心感，暂时逃避被评判的Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected，老板not满、Tense relationships with colleagues；压力与内疚加剧，Impaired self-esteem

antecedent: 出门前准备not足或时间紧迫
target_behavior.core_reason: 对“必须完美准时”的非黑即白信念与对负面结果的预测not yet来
target_behavior.function: Drives action by raising arousal (self-stimulation/mobilization), but causes inefficiency and chaos
target_behavior.consequence: 计划混乱、耗时增加，迟到加剧并在全天维持高紧张水平
